blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Costa Mesa
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: South Coast Plaza and John Wayne Airport form one of the region's largest commercial clusters, where parking is structured, paid and often full.
John Wayne Airport curbside pickup is separate from the mall, so a single vehicle covers both airport arrival and the evening.
Segerstrom Center and the OC Fairgrounds are about 10 minutes apart across city streets that jam hard on event nights.
SNA is the smallest and least congested airport to drive in Southern California, making chauffeured arrivals attractive for out-of-town guests.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Costa Mesa Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

blocks.text: Licensed, Insured, and Backup Plans

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
